basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Applied AI Engineer | Production LLM Systems | Model → System → Product
basics.summary: Applied AI engineer who owns LLM features from prompt to production. Lead AI Engineer at LumApps building multi-agent workflows on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK: prompts, tools, memory, evals, tracing, and cost-per-request instrumentation. 2x outbound conversions, $1M forecast in quarterly revenue. Prior LLM pipelines shipped at Beekeeper ($337K/yr vendor cost eliminated in 6 weeks) and 3 AI products founded on the side (PulseView, Proplab, SwissNRI). ML foundation from EPFL research (neural networks, genetic algorithms, embodied learning). Comfortable across the stack: model, orchestration, infra, UX.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Shipped production multi-agent workflows on Python, LangGraph, Google ADK over Vertex AI. ReAct with self-reflection, tools over MCP, state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. Verification loops and human-in-the-loop checkpoints turn raw outputs into structured, reliable behaviors. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M forecast quarterly.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, product usage) into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes. Grounds RAG so agents stop hallucinating; long-running workflows keep persistent context.

Built the evaluation and reliability layer: lightweight eval pipelines, LangSmith tracing, tool-selection tuning, cost-per-request instrumentation, fallback/retry paths for LLM and tool failures, and on-call for global production.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Replaced $337K/yr in vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions + OpenAI). 12K+ assets translated; product team iterates without a gatekeeper.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist and a GenAI demo generator: LLM-powered features shipped end to end (prompts, orchestration, UI, evals). Improved demo speed, close rates, time-to-first-value.
Designed a distributed templating engine that cut customer setup time 90% and powers 15% of all assets on the platform (10M+ users). Product Owner; concept to production.
Ran observability and global on-call (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io); built and mentored the AI engineering cohort. Deputy tech lead of FUEL.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Shipped end-to-end delivery platform with real-time flight-control APIs and logistics optimization. 500+ autonomous last-mile deliveries; 99.5% safety record.
Built cloud infra and CI/CD from scratch (AWS, Docker, Terraform). Enabled Unilever partnership and a CES showcase.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform where robot bodies and neural controllers co-evolve via genetic algorithms.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
TA for Evolutionary Robotics; supervised 20+ master's students on optimization, neural networks, and embodied learning. ML foundation for my applied LLM work today.

projects.name: PulseView - Explainable AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence for retail traders. AI agents generate AND justify trading signals from technical and news data; if the model cannot explain the signal, it does not ship. Solo end to end: structured outputs, evals, live users on real-time feeds.

projects.name: Proplab - AI-Native Property Workflows
projects.description: Vision pipeline extracts structured signals (room type, condition, defects) from inspection photos, replacing paper reports with queryable, AI-readable data. LLM agents then compose multilingual, marketing-ready listings end to end.
